{"draft": "Cummins fourth-quarter profit rises as revenue edges higher
Cummins Inc. reported fourth-quarter revenue of $8.5 billion, up 1% from a year earlier, while net income attributable to the company climbed to $593 million, or $4.27 per diluted share, from $418 million, or $3.02 per diluted share.
EBITDA grew to $1.2 billion, or 13.5% of sales, from $1.0 billion, or 12.1% of sales. Results included electrolyzer-related charges of $218 million, or $1.54 per diluted share, within Accelera.
Sales in North America slipped 2%, while international revenues rose 5%.
For the full year, the company posted revenue of $33.7 billion, down 1%, and net income of $2.8 billion, or $20.50 per diluted share. Full-year results included electrolyzer charges of $458 million, or $3.28 per diluted share.
Cummins projected that full-year 2026 revenue will increase 3% to 8%, with EBITDA ranging from 17.0% to 18.0% of sales.
The company also said it returned $1,055 million to shareholders through dividends during 2025."}
